name: DivisionOrderOwnerManager
tagline: Owner decimals, division orders, suspense and escheat – in one Power Apps control
description: A complete land & revenue module for oil and gas operators: owner revenue interests by property with a DOI balance check to 1.00000000, division order status from title review to pay, suspense with a release checklist, state escheat countdowns and an owner change queue for transfers, probate, address, TIN and name changes. Works in canvas apps, model-driven apps and Power Pages.
features: DOI decimal balance per property with out-of-balance alert and optional pay block
Title review → DO sent → Signed → In pay workflow with rules
Suspense by reason with release checklist and bulk release
State escheat dormancy countdown and unclaimed property reporting
Owner change queue: transfer, probate, address, TIN, name – execute transfer creates the new owner line
Bulk send DOs / mark signed / suspend, undo, CSV export
Power Fx outputs and events (OnSave, OnCreate, OnAction, OnStatusChange)
